pergunta: Quais são os nomes das pistas sem uma corrida na classe 'GT'?
esperado: SELECT name FROM track EXCEPT SELECT T2.name FROM race AS T1 JOIN track AS T2 ON T1.track_id = T2.track_id WHERE T1.class = 'GT'
gerado: SELECT t1.name FROM track AS t1 JOIN race AS t2 ON t1.track_id = t2.track_id WHERE NOT t2.class = 'GT'

pergunta: Que curso tem maior número de alunos registrados?
esperado: SELECT T1.course_name FROM courses AS T1 JOIN student_course_registrations AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_Id GROUP BY T1.course_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
gerado: SELECT course_name FROM courses WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_Id FROM student_course_registrations GROUP BY course_Id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

pergunta: Encontre a localização e a pontuação de todos os jogos da escola que tem Clemson como nome da equipe.

gerado: SELECT T2.location, T1.All_Games FROM university AS T1 JOIN basketball_match AS T2 ON T1.school_id = T2.school_id WHERE T1.name LIKE "Clemson%"
